provider.name: International Plant Names Index
provider.organization_type: global plant nomenclature, authorship, bibliography, identifier, publication, historical-index, search, API, and data-integration infrastructure
provider.description: The International Plant Names Index provides nomenclatural information for vascular plants and selected other botanical groups. It records scientific names, authorship, publication details, nomenclatural status, persistent identifiers, author abbreviations, publication abbreviations, historical source indexes, search services, APIs, and bulk data. IPNI is primarily a nomenclatural resource rather than an accepted-name taxonomy.
institutional_context: Australian National Herbarium and Australian Plant Names Index
International botanical nomenclature and taxonomy community

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting IPNI documentation, plant-name records, authors, publications, nomenclatural status, identifiers, historical sources, APIs, downloads, standards, related authorities, licenses, citations, and institutional context.
purpose.authoritative_notice: IPNI, its partner institutions, applicable nomenclatural codes, cited publications, and official API or download releases remain authoritative for plant names, identifiers, authorship, publication details, status, versions, licenses, citations, and contacts.
